newsitem.title: USA: Ala. Power restores service after tornadoes.
newsitem.headline: Ala. Power restores service after tornadoes.

text.p: Alabama Power Co, a subsidiary of Southern Co, said Monday it restored service to customers who were affected by one of several tornadoes that swept through parts of the southeastern U.S. this weekend.
"We had some minor floods and a tornado in Tuscaloosa," a company spokesman said.
The twister was strong enough to level a shopping center in the city located 50 miles west of Birmingham, he noted.
The spokesman said the outage to 8,000 customers in northern Alabama was relatively minor. The utility serves 1.2 million customers in the state.
The storm did damage some transmission equipment, but they were quickly repaired, he added.
At least eight tornadoes ripped through an eight-county area south of Nashville late Saturday, damaging or destroying about 250 homes.
Tennessee Valley Authority, the largest power provider in the Southeast, said its operations were running normally.
